He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Belmont Bruins men's basketball|Belmont Bruins]], [[Maryland Terrapins men's basketball|Maryland Terrapins]] and [[Tennessee Volunteers basketball|Tennessee Volunteers]]. ==Early life and high school== Gillespie attended [[Greeneville High School]] in [[Greeneville, Tennessee]]. He committed to play [[college basketball]] for the [[Belmont Bruins men's basketball|Belmont Bruins]] over from schools such as [[Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball|Vanderbilt]], [[Virginia Tech Hokies men's basketball|Virginia Tech]] and [[Eastern Kentucky Colonels men's basketball|Eastern Kentucky]].{{cite web |last1=Woodroof |first1=Cory |title=5 things to know about Maryland star Ja'Kobi Gillespie |url=https://ftw.usatoday.com/story/sports/ncaab/2025/03/21/march-madness-maryland-jakobi-gillespie-ncaa-tournament/82504483007/ |website=USA Today |access-date=24 March 2025}} ==College career== === Belmont === As a [[freshman]] in 2022-23, Gillespie averaged 9.6 points and 3.3 assists per game and was named to the [[Missouri Valley Conference]] (MVC) All-Freshman Team.{{cite web |last1=Sampson |first1=Joshua |title=For Maryland’s Ja’Kobi Gillespie, Basketball Was Always The Path |url=https://pressboxonline.com/2024/12/18/for-marylands-jakobi-gillespie-basketball-was-always-the-path/ |website=PressBox Online |access-date=24 March 2025}} In 2023-24, he averaged 17.2 points, 4.2 assists, 3.8 rebounds, and 2.2 steals per game and earned second-team all-MVC honors, MVC All-Defensive Team honors, while also being named to the MVC Most Improved Team.{{cite web |last1=Smith |first1=Kaiden |title=Former Belmont guard Ja'Kobi Gillespie commits to Maryland |url=https://www.on3.com/transfer-portal/news/former-belmont-guard-jakobi-gillespie-commits-maryland-ncaa-transfer-portal/ |website=On3.com |access-date=24 March 2025}} After the season, Gillespie entered his name into the [[NCAA transfer portal]].{{cite web |last1=Johnson |first1=Cole |title=Former Mr. Basketball and Greeneville standout Ja'Kobi Gillespie commits to Maryland |url=https://wcyb.com/sports/local-college/former-greeneville-standout-jakobi-gillespie-commits-to-maryland-after-leaving-belmont |website=WCYB.com |access-date=24 March 2025}} === Maryland === Gillespie transferred to play for the [[Maryland Terrapins men's basketball|Maryland Terrapins]]. On December 4, 2024, he recorded 23 points and four assists in victory over [[2024–25 Ohio State Buckeyes men's basketball team|Ohio State]].{{cite web |last1=Lee |first1=Edward |title=Maryland’s Ja’Kobi Gillespie rises to Kevin Willard’s challenge vs. Ohio State |url=https://www.baltimoresun.com/2024/12/05/takeaways-maryland-mens-basketball-ohio-state/ |website=Baltimore Sun |access-date=24 March 2025}} On December 21, Gillespie recorded 17 points, 11 assists and five rebounds in a victory against [[2024–25 Syracuse Orange men's basketball team|Syracuse]].{{cite web |last1=Rich |first1=Harrison |title=Ja’Kobi Gillespie, Selton Miguel help Maryland men’s basketball pummel Syracuse, 87-60 |url=https://dbknews.com/2024/12/21/maryland-mens-basketball-score-recap-result-syracuse/ |website=The Diamondback |access-date=24 March 2025}} On January 10, 2025, he notched a career-high 27 points, four assists, and four steals in a win over [[2024–25 UCLA Bruins men's basketball team|UCLA]].{{cite web |last1=Lee |first1=Edward |title=Ja’Kobi Gillespie, Terps’ defense bounce back at the perfect time |url=https://www.baltimoresun.com/2025/01/11/takeaways-maryland-mens-basketball-ucla/ |website=Baltimore Sun |access-date=24 March 2025}} On January 19, Gillespie notched 1,000 career points after scoring 22 in victory over [[2024–25 Nebraska Cornhuskers men's basketball team|Nebraska]].{{cite web |last1=Gerbo |first1=George |title=Gillespie scores 22, reaches 1,000 point plateau as Maryland holds on to beat Nebraska |url=https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2025/jan/19/ja-kobi-gillespie-scores-22-reaches-1-000-point-pl/ |website=The Washington Times |access-date=24 March 2025}} On January 26, he posted 18 points, nine assists, three rebounds, one steal, and one block versus [[2024–25 Indiana Hoosiers men's basketball team|Indiana]].{{cite web |last1=Breiler |first1=Chris |title=Maryland Basketball: Ja'Kobi Gillespie makes watchlist for prestigious award |url=https://www.si.com/college/maryland/basketball/maryland-basketball-jakobi-gillespie-makes-watchlist-for-oscar-robertson-trophy |work=Maryland Terrapins on SI |publisher=SI.com |access-date=24 March 2025}} For his performance during the 2024-25 season, Gillespie was named third-team [[List of All-Big Ten Conference men's basketball teams|All-Big Ten Conference]].{{cite web |last1=Rich |first1=Harrison |title=Behind Ja’Kobi Gillespie’s quiet demeanor is a ‘killer instinct’ |url=https://dbknews.com/2025/03/19/maryland-mens-basketball-jakobi-gillespie-kevin-willard-ncaa-tournament/ |website=The Diamondback |access-date=24 March 2025}} === Tennessee === Gillespie transferred to play for the [[Tennessee Volunteers men's basketball|Tennessee Volunteers]]. He averaged 18.4 points, 5.4 assists and 2.8 rebounds per game in his only season for the team.{{cite news |last1=Ramey |first1=Grant |title=Where Felix Okpara, Ja'Kobi Gillespie are projected in new ESPN NBA mock draft |url=https://www.on3.com/teams/tennessee-volunteers/news/tennessee-vols-basketball-nba-mock-draft-espn-felix-okpara-jakobi-gillespie/ |access-date=May 14, 2026 |work=On3.com |date=May 13, 2026}} == Professional career == On June 24, 2026, the [[San Antonio Spurs]] selected Gillespie with the 42nd overall pick in the [[2026 NBA draft]].{{Cite web |last=Douglas |first=Jacob |date=June 24, 2026 |title=San Antonio selects Ja’Kobi Gillespie with the 42nd pick |url=https://www.poundingtherock.com/spurs-draft-rumors-news-analysis/105647/san-antonio-selects-jakobi-gillespie-with-the-42nd-pick |url-status=live |access-date=June 25, 2026 |website=poundingtherock.com}} He signed a [[two-way contract]] with Spurs on 3 July, 2026.{{cite web |title=Spurs' four draft picks sign rookie deals|url=https://www.expressnews.com/sports/spurs/article/spurs-four-draft-picks-sign-rookie-deals-22331970.php|website=expressnews.com|date=July 3, 2026}} == References == {{reflist}} ==External
